fundamentals.name: Netflix, Inc.
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: Netflix, Inc. provides entertainment services worldwide. The company offers television (TV) series, documentaries, feature films, games, and live programming across various genres and languages. It also provides members the ability to receive streaming content through a host of internet-connected devices, including TVs, digital video players, TV set-top boxes, and mobile devices. Netflix, Inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Los Gatos, California.

judgment.summary: Strongly growing business with excellent margins and robust free cash flow, trading at a reasonable forward multiple.
judgment.earningsRecap: Last quarter missed EPS estimate by 1.4%; next earnings date is 2026-07-16.
positives: Revenue growth 16.2% YoY and analyst estimates for 42.3% FY growth indicate strong top-line expansion.
Exceptional margins (Gross 49.0%, Operating 32.3%, Profit 28.5%) and high returns (ROE 48.5%) highlight operational efficiency.
Free cash flow (TTM) of $25.99B is substantial, supporting the business without significant leverage concerns.
Forward P/E of 21.47x is attractive given the growth and profitability profile.
Analyst consensus is 'buy' with a mean target of $114.56.
negatives: Last quarter's EPS missed estimates by 1.4%.
Debt/Equity ratio of 53.79% is notable, though offset by strong cash flow.
Beta of 1.49 suggests higher volatility than the market.

news.paragraph: Netflix has seen a notable downturn recently, with shares dropping more than the broader market. This follows news of the company withdrawing from an acquisition, which appears to have been met with market approval, yet the stock continues to trend lower. Analysts are watching the company's growth estimates for the current quarter and fiscal year, with the next earnings date set for mid-July.
